setting.activity: Setting up a mayoral press conference

dialog.input_text: Will the mayor be taking any questions from the press after the main statement?
dialog.agent_text: Yes, there will be a brief period for questions immediately following the statement.

dialog.input_text: The glare from the glass building behind the podium is ruining the shot. We need to frame this differently.
Just zoom in closer. We don't have time to reposition the whole crew.
Actually, could we just shift the podium a little bit to the left to avoid the reflection?
dialog.agent_text: I can authorize a slight adjustment to the podium placement. Let us move it carefully so we do not disconnect the microphones.

dialog.input_text: Thank you, that fixes the problem completely.
dialog.agent_text: I am glad to help. Ensuring a clear broadcast is beneficial for everyone.

dialog.input_text: Well, as long as I can still step up to the mic for my question, I don't mind.
dialog.agent_text: You will have plenty of space to approach the microphone during the designated time.
